sources.shortCitation: Hänsom Filmbilder, series 6, card 215 — Franz Grothe, Olly Gebauer, Liane Haid
sources.fullCitation: Film-collector’s card, Hänsom Filmbilder, series 6, no. 215: “Franz Grothe — Olly Gebauer — Liane Haid.” Photograph credited “Ross” (Ross Verlag, Berlin); the card carries the Hänsom monogram. Germany, 1930s. Reproduced at Virtual History, person record for Franz Grothe.
sources.title: Franz Grothe, Olly Gebauer and Liane Haid — Hänsom Filmbilder card
sources.creator: Photograph credited to Ross Verlag, Berlin
sources.researchNote: The source is a digital reproduction of Hänsom Filmbilder, series 6, card 215. Virtual History lists Franz Grothe, Olly Gebauer and Liane Haid for this card. The approximate dating to the 1930s refers to the printed card, not to the underlying photograph; neither an exact issue year nor a photography date has been established. The physical card has not been examined.
